name: Imogen Heap
tagline: THE NINE · the godmother of onchain music · Mycelia · Auracles
bio: Released 'Tiny Human' on the Ethereum blockchain in October 2015 via the Ujo Music experiment — one of the first blockchain-released songs in history. Founded Mycelia and The Creative Passport (now Auracles.io): music-makers holding their own data, deciding what they share — the node-spec vision a decade early. Grammy winner (Best Engineered Album, Non-Classical, for Ellipse — the second woman ever to win it), creator of 'Hide and Seek', inventor of the MI.MU gloves, builder of the consent-first AI twin ai.Mogen. Node 009: the nine, completion — the godmother completes the circle she began.
quote: I want to hear things that humans have never imagined.
songs_note: Nothing appears on this node without Imogen's blessing, item by item — a rule the orchestra learned from her own Creative Passport. This page is an invitation written from public sources only — the chair is held.
